# FLX-2110: run artifacts do not reproduce the recorded run digest

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC section 10 builds the run digest from one component digest per artifact: each emit stream's framed outputDigest, the raw bytes of decisions.ndjson, and the trace ledgers. `fluxsim verify` and `fluxsim ship` recompute every one of them from the files on disk and compare. A difference means the run directory no longer holds the bytes the recorded digest was taken over -- a stream was edited, truncated or replaced after `apply` wrote it, or an artifact is missing. Re-run `fluxsim apply` (or `fluxsim replay --assert-digest`) rather than shipping artifacts nothing in the run produced.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2110
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
